text.easy_npc.faction.internal_dispute.0: The %s guards fold their arms. This one is between you two.
text.easy_npc.faction.internal_dispute.1: %s stays out of it. Nobody wants to do that paperwork.
text.easy_npc.faction.internal_dispute.2: The %s guards suddenly find the ceiling very interesting.
text.easy_npc.faction.internal_dispute.3: %s has declared this a private matter and gone back to work.
text.easy_npc.item.npc_coin: NPC currency item for quests, checks, trades and custom rewards.
text.easy_npc.item.npc_key: NPC key item for quests, checks, access control and custom locks.
text.easy_npc.item.npc_red_token: Red NPC token for quests, checks, trades and custom rewards.
text.easy_npc.dialog.button.duplicate_la: The button label %s is already used by another button of this dialog.

text.easy_npc.preset.exported_without_id: Exported "%1$s" without an NPC ID, importing it always creates a new NPC.
text.easy_npc.preset.imported_replaced: Imported "%1$s" and replaced the existing NPC %2$s, which had a different entity type.
text.easy_npc.preset.restore_denied: You are not allowed to restore an NPC with its stored ID and position.

tooltip.easy_npc.spawner.world_spawner: The World Spawner is a group spawner that counts its preset population across the whole world (all dimensions).
